items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-02-03
items.q: How long have you known him, Louie? All my life. We went to school together, fifth school... Him and I are the same age

ctx.x: Well who was in Joe Oliver's band when he was at Pete Lawrence? Old man Valto, he was playing violin.

Is it Freddie Washington piano player? Yeah, Freddie Washington on piano. Who else was on triumphant? I can't say, I'm scared to say. You have to ask Pete, you see. Pete and Manny Manetta, see they can tell you more about it. Because I was a kid, I couldn't go down in the district. When I went down there to play, police stopped me and Lewis two, three times, you know. When they put us in jail, you know. But I told him I had a mother and didn't have no father, you see. And I had to try to help my mother make a…
What was he like before he took out traffic? Was he playing anything else?
